summary: Tested ERP bug fixes and enhancements: subscription code popup after login, sidebar subscription code display, permission icons with green/red colors, print/export functionality across HR Salaries, Financial Reports, and Attendance modules

issues: Main content area appears empty/blank - may need UI content for settings page

subscription_code_popup_after_login.details: Modal showing 'Your Subscription Code: 98998604' appears after login with Copy Code and Continue to Application buttons

subscription_code_in_sidebar.details: Subscription Code section visible in sidebar with code 98998604 and copy icon

permission_icons_with_colors.details: 9 green icons (allowed) and 2 red icons (not allowed) displayed under Permissions section in sidebar

salaries_module_print_export.details: HR > Salaries module shows CSV, PDF, and Print buttons in top-right corner

financial_reports_pdf_export.details: Reports > Financial Reports shows CSV, PDF, and Print buttons. Multiple tabs available: Executive Summary, Profit & Loss, Cash Flow, Balance Sheet, KPIs

attendance_csv_export.details: Attendance module Reports tab shows Export CSV, Export PDF, and Print buttons with Generate Report functionality

print_hides_sidebar_css.details: @media print CSS rules in index.css properly hide sidebar, aside, nav elements and expand main content to full width

dashboard_navigation.details: Dashboard loads with statistics cards, Quick Actions, Recent Activity, and Upcoming Tasks

hr_submodules_accessible.details: HR section expandable showing Overview, Salaries, Allowances & Overtime, Deductions, Casual Leave, Annual Leave, Attendance, Reports submenus

action_items: Consider adding content to Settings page main area - currently shows empty content
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested features verified working: 1) Subscription code modal shows after login with code 98998604, 2) Subscription code visible in sidebar, 3) Permission icons display with green (allowed) and red (not allowed) colors, 4) Print/CSV/PDF export buttons present in Salaries, Financial Reports, and Attendance modules, 5) @media print CSS properly hides sidebar
